countries.name: Trinidad and Tobago
countries.summary: Trinidad and Tobago is a Caribbean twin-island republic whose main university campus is at St Augustine, near Port of Spain. The University of the West Indies campus hosts medicine and health-sciences training.
countries.whyStudentsChooseIt: Students can consider Trinidad and Tobago for an English-medium medical programme within the regional University of the West Indies system. The St Augustine route combines pre-clinical study with clinical training and a Caribbean campus setting.
countries.climate: Trinidad and Tobago has a tropical maritime climate, with warm temperatures throughout the year and a distinct wetter season. Students should plan for humidity and seasonal rainfall.

universities.name: University of the West Indies St. Augustine MBBS
universities.summary: The University of the West Indies (UWI) St. Augustine offers a direct-entry Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) programme in Trinidad and Tobago. Entry combines secondary-science preparation, an age threshold and non-academic evidence. The 2026/27 undergraduate cycle runs 5 January-17 July 2026. The school is listed in the World Directory of Medical Schools, and CAAM-HP records the UWI School of Medicine as accredited with conditions for 2023-2028.
universities.campusLifestyle: The MBBS programme is part of UWI St Augustine's Faculty of Medical Sciences, with the World Directory listing its address at Eric Williams Medical Sciences Complex, Mount Hope. The programme's fee booklet distinguishes pre-clinical Years 1-3 from clinical Years 4-5, and current admissions materials describe it as a full-time Faculty of Medical Sciences programme.
universities.cityProfile: The medical school is located at the Eric Williams Medical Sciences Complex in Mount Hope, St Augustine, Trinidad and Tobago. The official materials reviewed do not provide a current MBBS-specific housing or living-cost budget, so no cost estimate is added to the tuition state.
universities.practicalExposure: UWI's current MBBS fee information distinguishes pre-clinical Years 1-3 and clinical Years 4-5, including clerkship or rotation activity in the later years. The World Directory lists clinical training for the school. The reviewed sources do not guarantee a named clinical placement for every incoming student, so this package does not promise a particular hospital or rotation site.
universities.hostelOverview: No current MBBS-specific residence price, allocation policy or guaranteed housing arrangement was verified in the official sources used for this package. Housing is not included in the programme fee state.
universities.dietarySupport: The reviewed MBBS, admissions and fee materials do not publish a Medicine-specific meal plan or dietary-support benefit. Food costs need to be planned separately from tuition and compulsory university charges.
universities.safetyOverview: The reviewed official sources do not publish MBBS-specific safety statistics. UWI's undergraduate information directs students to university services including counselling, academic advising and special-needs support.
universities.studentSupport: UWI's undergraduate information lists academic advising, counselling and psychological services, student-services support and services for students with special needs. The MBBS selection process also gives applicants a structured admissions route through the undergraduate application system and Faculty requirements.
whyChoose: A direct-entry MBBS route with secondary-level science requirements and an English-language application system.
A documented pre-clinical Years 1-3 and clinical Years 4-5 structure.
A current 2026/27 undergraduate application period from 5 January to 17 July 2026.
World Directory of Medical Schools listing and a current CAAM-HP status for the UWI School of Medicine.
A formal selection process that considers both academic preparation and six months of certified service or relevant activities.
thingsToConsider: Applicants must be at least 18 by admission or 31 December of the entry year.
MBBS applicants need qualifying secondary science preparation, a 250-300-word autobiographical sketch and certified evidence of at least six months of relevant activities or community service.
Medical Sciences programmes normally require the MBBS to be the applicant's first choice.
The current complete MBBS fee booklet is 2025/26, not 2026/27, so this package does not publish a stale annual tuition figure.
Professional registration, licensing and residency requirements remain specific to the country where a graduate plans to practise.
bestFitFor: Applicants aged 18 or reaching 18 by the end of the entry year with strong Chemistry, Biology and science preparation.
Students able to document sustained community, voluntary or related activity as part of a competitive selection process.
Applicants seeking an English-language Caribbean medical programme with separate pre-clinical and clinical stages.

faq.question: Is UWI St Augustine MBBS direct-entry after secondary school?
faq.answer: Yes. UWI's Faculty requirements set a secondary-level route: five qualifying subjects including English, Chemistry, Physics, Biology and Mathematics, plus advanced Chemistry, Biology and another subject or an approved equivalent.

faq.question: What age is required for MBBS admission?
faq.answer: Applicants must be at least 18 at admission or by 31 December of the year of entry.

faq.question: What non-academic evidence is required?
faq.answer: MBBS applicants submit a 250-300-word autobiographical sketch and certified evidence of relevant activities, social projects or voluntary community service for at least six months. UWI says this evidence is due by 30 June of the entry year.

faq.question: What is the 2026/27 application period?
faq.answer: UWI St Augustine states that undergraduate applications for 2026/27 open on 5 January 2026 and close on 17 July 2026. Faculty-specific selection materials and deadlines also apply.

faq.question: What is the current MBBS tuition?
faq.answer: A complete 2026/27 MBBS fee schedule was not publicly verified for this bundle. The latest complete undergraduate fee booklet located is for 2025/26, so no prior-year tuition is presented as current.

faq.question: How is the programme structured?
faq.answer: The official fee booklet distinguishes pre-clinical MBBS Years 1-3 from clinical Years 4-5, including clerkship or rotation activity in the clinical years.

faq.question: Is the programme internationally listed?
faq.answer: The school is listed in the World Directory of Medical Schools as currently operational. CAAM-HP's current assessed-programmes list records the UWI School of Medicine as accredited with conditions for 2023-2028.

faq.question: Must MBBS be my first-choice programme?
faq.answer: UWI's general matriculation information says Faculty of Medical Sciences programmes including MBBS normally consider only applicants who indicate the programme as their first choice.

faq.question: What student support is published?
faq.answer: UWI lists academic advising, counselling and psychological services, student-services support and services for students with special needs. It does not turn these services into a guarantee of academic progression or accommodation.

fee.notes: The latest complete official undergraduate fee booklet found is 2025/26 and contains MBBS fee information, but a current 2026/27 MBBS tuition schedule was not publicly verified. eligibleAudiences: Applicants meeting UWI matriculation and Faculty of Medical Sciences MBBS science requirements
Applicants who are at least 18 at admission or by 31 December of the entry year
restrictions: Five qualifying subjects must include English Language, Chemistry, Physics, Biology and Mathematics
Advanced Chemistry, Biology and another approved subject are required
Applicants submit a career-choice sketch and certified evidence of at least six months of relevant activities or service
MBBS is normally considered only when indicated as the applicant's first choice
audienceEligibility.notes: Faculty selection also applies its prevailing score and may consider approved tertiary pathways under the published requirements.

admissionsContent.overview: Applicants submit one online undergraduate application for the academic year and select MBBS as their first choice. They meet the University and Faculty science requirements, submit their academic records and non-academic selection evidence, and follow the current Faculty and admissions calendar.

eligibility.intro: MBBS entry requires approved secondary-school science qualifications, the stated age threshold and competitive Faculty selection. UWI also assesses documented non-academic preparation.
items: At least 18 at admission or by 31 December of the entry year
Five approved secondary subjects including English, Chemistry, Physics, Biology and Mathematics
Advanced Chemistry, Biology and another approved subject or equivalent
Certified evidence of six months of relevant activity, social projects or voluntary community service

applicationSteps: Submit one online undergraduate application and select MBBS as first choice
Provide approved academic qualifications and any required certified translations
Submit the certified non-academic selection form by 30 June of the entry year
Monitor the admissions system for document processing and decision updates

academic: Secondary-school examination records meeting the Faculty science requirements
Approved equivalent or tertiary records where applying through an alternative published pathway
Certified English translations for documents issued in another language
application: Certified non-academic criteria form and activity evidence

admissionsContent.deadlinesNote: UWI St Augustine's 2026/27 undergraduate cycle opens 5 January 2026 and closes 17 July 2026. MBBS non-academic evidence is due no later than 30 June of the entry year.
visaConsiderations: The reviewed MBBS admissions materials do not publish a programme-specific immigration route. International applicants need to follow the applicable Trinidad and Tobago immigration requirements after admission.

programmes.feeNotes: The official 2025/26 fee booklet confirms that MBBS uses separate pre-clinical and clinical stages, but it is not used as a current 2026/27 tuition quote. Current tuition and compulsory fees are on request for this payload.
